_comment: MCP server stubs for the orchestration plugin. Anything needing a token references an environment variable — NEVER hardcode secrets here. Env vars are expanded as ${VAR}. This file is committed, so it must stay secret-free. NOTE: only real server definitions may live under "mcpServers" — per-server notes are kept in "_serverNotes" below, because any key inside "mcpServers" (including "//"-prefixed ones) is parsed as a server, and a string value there fails validation and marks the whole plugin as failed to load.

_serverNotes.git: Local git operations over MCP. No token required. Requires the uvx-installed mcp-server-git (https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers).
_serverNotes.github: GitHub API access (PRs, issues, repo metadata). Requires a Personal Access Token supplied via the GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable — do NOT paste a token here. Set it in your shell/.env (which is gitignored) before starting Claude Code.
_serverNotes.filesystem: Scoped filesystem access. No token required. Replace ${PWD} or the args with the specific directory you want to expose; keep the scope as narrow as the work needs.
